headline: IMF Cuts Global Growth Forecast Amid Renewed Strait of Hormuz Attacks and US-Iran War Fallout.
summary: The escalation of the US-Iran conflict, marked by renewed attacks in the critical Strait of Hormuz, has led the IMF to significantly cut its 2026 world growth forecast. This development poses a severe threat to global energy supply chain logistics, amplifies geopolitical instability in the Middle East, and will have widespread indirect impacts on all industries, including the tech sector.
